class.name: OasisSprings3D
class.brief_description: Still pools at desert springs, each sized by its water balance, with sand boils at the vents.
class.description: Oasis pools where a confined aquifer reaches the surface (the springs of Siwa or the Great Artesian Basin). Each spring gets a [PhysXWaterSurface3D] whose area is set by the water balance at steady state: the pool grows until evaporation and seepage take what the spring gives, area = discharge / ([method evaporation_at] + [member seepage]). A spring of 0.05 L/s against 3.5 m a year holds about 450 m², a pool 24 m across. The outline is a disc broken by harmonics 2 to 7 with random shares and phases drawn from the spring's position and [member seed], so no two pools share a shape, scaled to hold exactly the balance's area. The spring's vent sits off the pool's centre by up to [member vent_offset] of its radius. The pool measures its bed from the ground ([member seabed_from_floor]), so the ground's hollow should meet [method get_outline] (terrain carves the basin; the pool does not). At each vent (one to three, a pace or so apart) a sand boil: a cone of sand thrown out round a throat whose floor heaves as the flow surges, grains dancing on it, the same function under raster and path tracing; the water surface over it lifts in a faint dome that sheds rings.

method.name: evaporation_at
method.description: The open-water evaporation in use at a height (m a year): [member evaporation] when set, else the weather's climate by Hargreaves and Samani (1985) with [member diurnal_range] (FAO-56 radiation, open water 1.05 of the reference), else 2.5 m.

method.name: get_outline
method.description: The pool's outline in world X/Z (128 points at even angles round its centre): the shore the ground's hollow should meet.

method.name: get_pool
method.description: The pool at [param index], a [PhysXWaterSurface3D] (an internal child).

method.name: get_pool_area
method.description: The pool's area (m²) from the water balance, clamped by [member min_radius] and [member max_radius].

method.name: get_pool_count
method.description: How many pools there are (one per spring).

method.name: get_pool_discharge
method.description: The spring's discharge (L/s) the pool was sized for.

method.name: get_pool_radius
method.description: The radius (m) of a disc of the pool's area.

method.name: get_vents
method.description: The pool's vents on the measured bed (world positions; the bed heights land on the first physics frame).

method.name: pool_area
method.description: The area (m²) a spring of [param discharge] L/s holds against [param evaporation] + [param seepage] m a year.

method.name: rebuild
method.description: Builds the pools again from [member springs] and [member spring_source] (after the source's springs changed).

members.member: The radius (m) of each boil's cone crest; the sand it throws out reaches twice that.
How hard the boils heave and their grains dance, and how high the dome over them lifts.
The discharge (L/s) of a spring that gives none (w of 0).
The day's temperature range (K) for the climate's evaporation estimate: about 14 K in a desert, 8 K by the sea.
Open-water evaporation (m a year). 0 takes it from the weather's climate (see [method evaporation_at]).
The pool's depth (m) where no bed is measured, and the bed under a vent with no ground below it.
The largest pool radius (m); a bigger balance is clamped to it.
The smallest pool radius (m); a smaller balance is raised to it.
How far the outline swings from a circle, as a share of the radius (never pinched below 0.55 of it).
Sand boils at the vents and the dome over them.
The bed sand's colour round the vents, as the ground under the water draws it, so the boil's apron fades into it.
The physics layers the pools' beds and the vents are measured on.
Each pool measures its bed from static bodies below ([member PhysXWaterSurface3D.seabed_from_floor]); off, it is [member fallback_depth] deep everywhere.
Varies every pool's outline and vents together.
Water lost into the bed (m a year): about 1 m on sand, less on clay or rock.
A node with a [code]get_springs()[/code] method returning the same layout as [member springs] (a [PackedVector4Array], [PackedVector3Array] or [Array] of either); added to [member springs].
The springs: x, the still-water level y, z, and w the discharge in L/s (0 = [member default_discharge]).
How far the vent may sit from the pool's centre, as a share of its radius.
